name: JellyDefaults
description: Default home screen library order and library sorting for users.
overview: Define the home library order and library sorts once; new users get them automatically, existing users on request.

versions.changelog:
- Default library sorting: sort of each library's main tab, imported from a user, applied to new users and to existing users still on the default sort (per library)
- Optional admin sidebar entry
- Narrower settings page
